name: American Civil Liberties Union
self_described_orientation: UNKNOWN in inspected scorecard landing-page text
scope_note: The scorecard landing page was live but exposed little methodological text to the reader.

name: Heritage Action for America
self_described_orientation: Conservative; the publisher describes the scorecard as measuring how conservative members are.
scope_note: Uses the publisher's selected votes and cosponsorships; do not call it a neutral ranking.

name: National Taxpayers Union
self_described_orientation: Taxpayer perspective favoring lower spending, lower taxes and less regulation, as described by the publisher.
scope_note: Method and denominator differ from other publishers. Do not average their ratings into a common good-member score.

name: The Lugar Center / Georgetown University Bipartisan Index
self_described_orientation: Bipartisan legislative collaboration; not an ideological placement measure.
scope_note: Its sponsorship/cosponsorship collaboration lens should remain distinct from vote-alignment and ideological measures.
